en.name: Soy crumbles and soy hot dogs, frozen
en.summary: Frozen soy crumbles and soy hot dogs keep 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality — a tenth of what a frozen soy burger gets, and the shape is why. Crumbles are thousands of small separate pieces and a hot dog is an emulsion with oil worked all the way through it, so both present an enormous amount of oiled surface to freezer air. Keep them frozen and cook as directed; once cooked, they keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: None. Being meat-free changes nothing about the handling: these are moist, low-acid, high-protein foods with added oil, and bacteria find them every bit as hospitable as the meat originals. The two-hour rule applies in the 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) danger zone, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Soy hot dogs deserve particular care, because they are usually fully cooked and eaten as they are, so there is no heating step left in which a mistake could be put right.
en.fridge: The 3–4 day figure describes cooked product: covered, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Crumbles that have thawed but not been cooked are a different situation and want using within a day or two, sealed tightly — loose crumbles have so much surface that they dry into hard grains and take up fridge smells overnight. Move opened hot dogs into a box rather than leaving them in a slit pack, which does not reseal. Reheat to steaming rather than to lukewarm, and only the portion you are going to eat.
en.freezer: 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality, which is genuinely short and worth planning around. The reason is surface area. A frozen burger is one solid block with a small outside; a bag of crumbles is a mountain of separate grains, each one essentially all surface, and the vegetable oil in them meets freezer air on every face. Oxidation continues at −18 °C, only slowly — but with this much surface it does not have to be fast. An over-kept bag tastes stale, cardboardy, faintly of paint. That is a quality limit rather than a safety one; held continuously at −18 °C they stay safe indefinitely. Push the air out and clip the bag shut every time, and keep it away from the door.
en.thawing: Cook crumbles straight from frozen wherever the pack allows it, which is nearly always: they break apart in the pan and heat through in minutes, so you skip thawing altogether. Hot dogs go from frozen into simmering water or a hot pan. Otherwise thaw in the fridge, never on the counter. Something thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some loss of quality; anything that has warmed up may not.
spoilage: A stale, cardboardy or painty smell from the oil — the usual failure.
Dry, pale, crumbly patches — freezer burn.
A slimy or sticky surface on thawed hot dogs, which means they go out.
A solid welded block or heavy ice in the bag, meaning it part-thawed and refroze.
tips: Cook crumbles from frozen; they need no thawing at all.
Reseal the bag tightly with the air pressed out — the oil is what ages.
Label the bag with the date; one to two months goes quickly.
Treat soy hot dogs like any ready-to-eat product: keep them cold and do not leave them out.

faq.q: How long do frozen soy crumbles last?
faq.a: 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. They stay safe longer if they never thaw, but the oil in them goes stale.

faq.q: Do meat-free products need the same care as meat?
faq.a: Yes. They are moist, low-acid and high in protein, so they sit in the danger zone exactly the same way. Many are also ready-to-eat, which makes careful handling more important, not less.

faq.q: Can you cook soy crumbles from frozen?
faq.a: Yes, and it is the easiest way — they break apart and heat through in a few minutes straight from the bag.

zh.name: 冷凍素絞肉與素熱狗
zh.summary: 冷凍素絞肉與素熱狗在 −18 °C 下自購買日起品質最好的期間是 1～2 個月——只有冷凍素漢堡排的十分之一，而原因出在形狀。素絞肉是成千上萬顆各自分開的小顆粒，素熱狗則是把油整個打進去的乳化製品，兩者都把極大量含油的表面攤給冷凍庫的空氣。請保持冷凍並依指示烹調；煮熟之後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有。不是肉這件事不會改變任何處理方式：它們含水量高、低酸、高蛋白，而且加了油，對細菌來說和葷的原型一樣好客。在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。素熱狗尤其要小心，因為它通常是全熟、直接就吃的產品，後面不再有任何一道加熱可以把失誤補回來。
zh.fridge: 3～4 天講的是煮熟之後：蓋好放 4 °C 以下。已經解凍但還沒煮的素絞肉是另一回事，要密封並在一兩天內用掉——散開的顆粒表面積太大，放一個晚上就乾成硬粒，還把冰箱的味道全吸進去。開封的素熱狗請改裝進盒子，割開的包裝袋是封不回去的。回熱要熱到冒蒸氣，不要只是溫溫的，而且只熱你真的要吃的份量。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月品質最好，這確實很短，值得先安排好怎麼用完。原因是表面積。一片冷凍漢堡排是一整塊，外表面很小；一袋素絞肉卻是一座由獨立顆粒堆成的小山，每一顆幾乎全是表面，裡面的植物油每一面都碰得到冷凍庫的空氣。氧化在 −18 °C 仍然在進行，只是很慢——但表面積這麼大，它根本不需要快。放過頭的那一包吃起來就是走味、紙板味，甚至隱約像油漆。這是品質的上限，不是安全的：全程維持在 −18 °C 就一直是安全的。每次用完都把袋子裡的空氣壓掉、夾緊，並且遠離冷凍櫃門。
zh.thawing: 包裝允許的話，素絞肉直接從冷凍下鍋，而且幾乎都允許：它在鍋裡就會散開，幾分鐘就熱透，等於完全跳過解凍。素熱狗則可以從冷凍直接下滾水或下熱鍋。真的要解凍就放冷藏，絕對不要放檯面。在冷藏解凍、且一直維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；已經回溫的就不行。
spoilage: 油脂發出走味、紙板味或油漆味——最常見的結局。
出現乾燥、發白、粉碎的斑塊——那是凍燒。
解凍後的素熱狗表面黏滑或黏手，那就該丟。
整包凍成硬塊或結了厚冰，表示曾經半退冰又再凍。
tips: 素絞肉從冷凍直接煮，完全不必解凍。
每次都壓出空氣、把袋子封緊——會老化的是油脂。
袋上標日期；一到兩個月過得很快。
素熱狗請比照即食品處理：保持低溫，不要擺在外面。

faq.q: 冷凍素絞肉可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全，但裡面的油脂會走味。

faq.q: 素的產品需要和肉一樣小心嗎？
faq.a: 需要。它們同樣含水高、低酸又高蛋白，在危險溫度帶裡的行為完全一樣；而且很多是即食品，反而更該小心。

faq.q: 素絞肉可以從冷凍直接煮嗎？
faq.a: 可以，而且這是最省事的做法——直接下鍋幾分鐘就散開熱透了。
